cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've held my cup against my cheek like you. Was the other cup on the tray for someone who takes sugar?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm cooling a burn on my face. And yes, they took two spoonfuls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, temperature control. Was there a blue coat to hang up with that cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No coat. They only stayed long enough to drop off your library book.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then was a bicycle left against the wall? I'd hate the book to have made the trip in the rain.
